title: 'BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Las Vegas' Citywide Experience Closes — Final Day of 11-Day Fan Activation
detail: May 31, 2026 marks the final day of 'BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Las Vegas,' the 11-day citywide fan experience that ran May 21–31 alongside the ARIRANG World Tour Allegiant Stadium residency. The immersive citywide activation featured BTS-branded Las Vegas Monorail cars, a BTS pop-up store at The Forum Shops at Caesars Palace (May 21–28), large-scale ARIRANG visual installations across the Strip, and fan-only themed dining and photo experiences. The Samsung Galaxy × BTS ARIRANG fan activation at Allegiant Stadium — six themed activity zones showcasing the Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra, BTS-themed photo opportunities, and a multilingual messaging experience — also concludes today, closing the North American leg's official programming footprint. With the Vegas experience complete, BTS's North American presence concludes after approximately 260,000 fans attended the Allegiant Stadium shows (May 23–28, sold out in 23 minutes). The ARIRANG World Tour now turns to South Korea: 'BTS THE CITY ARIRANG Busan' opens June 5 across the city ahead of the Busan Asiad Main Stadium anniversary concerts on June 12–13 — BTS's 13th debut anniversary.

title: Nike × BTS ARIRANG Collection & Nike By You Experience Launch June 1 — BTS × Oreo Hotteok Cookies Also Go Live
detail: On the eve of June 1, 2026, ARMY worldwide prepare for two major brand partnership launches. The Nike × BTS ARIRANG collaboration — announced May 29 by Nike and HYBE — opens its Nike By You customization experience on June 1 at select Nike stores and online, offering 10 fan-designed custom BTS motif options for Nike apparel and totes in 20+ cities across the US, Europe, and Asia. The full Nike × BTS ARIRANG World Tour merchandise collection (T-shirts, hoodies, regional exclusives, and a Korea-only limited-edition ball cap) is slated for a June 12 in-store drop in Seoul, Busan, and Tokyo, with US cities (Chicago, Boston, San Francisco, LA, NYC, Las Vegas) receiving the collection on July 5. Simultaneously, the BTS × Oreo limited-edition hotteok-flavored cookie collaboration goes on sale June 1 in 80+ countries — announced May 26 and now approaching launch. With both partnerships activating as BTS travels back to South Korea, the marketing momentum around the group's Busan anniversary shows (June 12–13) continues to build.

media.caption: Nike × BTS ARIRANG World Tour collection and Nike By You customization experience launch June 1, 2026
